content.text: Now part 2: es-vox, ietf-ballot, fide-match, wikipedia, bun, go, node. Writing.

There are leaks/artifacts in part2 (leftover weird regexes in es-vox "voxSeatsM"; figure3 conclusion in ietf has malformed computed interpolation string; fide's nextWhiteM index group; go's assumption string expression weird). Rather than trying to make every regex perfect blind, I'll now write the seeds + refreshers registry, then RUN tests against the fixtures and fix parse bugs iteratively (that's the fastest path — the fixtures ARE the test).

Quick sanity notes for later fix-up:
- es-vox: my regexes are too speculative. The electografica fixture text: "...Vox subiría una décima, hasta el 19,1 %, y alcanzaría 64 diputados." — simple regexes: /Vox\s*\n?\s*subiría una décima, hasta el (\d{1,2},\d) %, y alcanzaría (\d{1,3}) diputados/. Simplify to that + fallbacks.
- Also the fgfsbern KM parse: kmSegment is "Kriegsmaterialgesetz" first occurrence — the survey may mention KM in intro; my Ja regex is "Aktuell würden (\d+) Prozent ... zustimmen, (\d+) Prozent" — in the gfsbern text: for KM section: "Aktuell würden 49 Prozent der teilnahmewilligen Stimmberechtigten bestimmt oder eher Ja stimmen, 46 Prozent bestimmt oder eher Nein" — my [^]*? between may span too far (first Aktuell würden is the AHV section: "Aktuell würden 46 Prozent... Ja stimmen, 51 Prozent ... Nein"). kmIdx first occurrence is likely in the intro paragraph ("während sich beim Kriegsmaterialgesetz ein enges Rennen...") — WRONG segment → would parse AHV numbers! Need to anchor to the KM section heading "Kriegsmaterialgesetz\n" near "Rennen"... Actually in the gfsbern page layout, the KM section header is like "Kriegsmaterialgesetz" followed by its paragraph. Better anchor: find LAST "Kriegsmaterialgesetz" occurrence or find "enges Rennen mit leichtem Ja-Vorteil" heading. In the fixture text, section headings: "Zusatzfinanzierung der AHV", "Feuerwerksinitiative", "Fairness-Initiative"(?...), "Kriegsmaterialgesetz"? Let me check the fixture during the test phase and then write pregular anchors.

Approach: write seeds + registry now (part3 with refreshers.ts aggregator), then specs.ts rewrite, then build and debug parsing against fixtures.
